title: 第6章 大醮成，采正炁
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

念头既定，陆玄不再思索，而是静心等待天时。

直到夜色深沉，时辰已到，陆玄袖袍一挥，当即从蛰院下发的储物袋中取出了此番大醮所需之物。

这是修士破境，祈新伟力、新境界的一种必须仪式。

只有大醮，才能引动天地变化，勾动道韵，得天之注目。

成了就可打破桎梏，得入下一境。

在陆玄目前的理解之中，颇有一种“向天科考”的意味。

但大醮玄妙，他境界太过低微，对上修之醮，只是猜测。

如今所能知晓的，仅仅是炼炁大醮。

炼炁大醮并不复杂，先以八座刻有大日云月篆文的金钟，布置在东、南、西、北等八极之地，荡平周天杂音杂炁。

再将两面刻有【元一真篆】的灵幡放置在三才中的天地二位，而后自身盘膝而坐，再举一幡，占据人位。

金钟灵幡，都不是凡物，须有灵之物方可，若是在外界，还需费上一番手脚，但在鉴天教中就很容易了。

陆玄取出金钟，金钟自然悬空，浮于云上，陆玄每隔十息，以玉槌敲响一座。

“铛！”

“铛！”

“铛！”

“……”

接连八声钟响，霎时间，八极方位，为之一震，陆玄尚无灵识，可依然感觉到了周身一静，似乎诸般杂炁和音都被钟声消弭了。

致虚极，守静笃。

周天静，心神宁，方能更好感知天地，于天合。

“呼！”

陆玄不敢耽搁，当即再次取出灵幡。

灵幡无风自动，悬于天地二位，幡声呼啸，但却并未冲散此方云亭的“静”，反而犹如灵讯一般，引动了天地的注意。

陆玄感觉到了，云亭之中，有莫名的“韵”在流动，远方山峦之中，似乎有诸般“炁”体将要悬浮而出。

至此，大醮仪式初成。

云亭之中已经有【天韵】流动，代表了此方之人，已经引起了天地的注目。

但……并未彻底功成。

还需最关键的一步。

得见天地，窥看大道，方可开启大醮。

胎息修士，不可见天，难以窥道，但在大醮之时，借助灵物和仪式，却可得见冥冥一缕。

鉴天教炼炁大醮的主材灵物，就是四相蓍草。

此草叶片细裂如羽，百年生一茎，得四相之灵气，可通神，能占卜。

借助此草，于大醮云亭之中，可窥一缕天。

能窥天，则可见【天试】。

若是用陆玄前世的话来说，就是可以看见“考题”了。

陆玄看了一眼天色，稍等了片刻，随即取出两枚如羽之灵叶，贴于自己眉间。

“咻！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

With the idea settled, Lu Xuan no longer thought about it, but quietly waited for the right time.

When the night fell and the time came, Lu Xuan waved his sleeves and immediately took out the things needed for this big ceremony from the storage bag issued by Zheyuan.

This is a necessary ritual for monks to break through the realm and pray for new great power and new realm.

Only the Great Jiao can induce changes in the heaven and earth, evoke the charm of Taoism, and win the attention of heaven.

Once you achieve it, you can break the shackles and enter the next realm.

In Lu Xuan's current understanding, it has a meaning of "scientific research toward the sky".

But the Great Jiao is mysterious, and his realm is too low, so he can only guess about the Jiao of Shangxiu.

What we can know now is only the Qi Dajiao.

The Qi Refining Dajiao is not complicated. First, eight golden bells engraved with the seal characters of the sun, cloud and moon are placed in the east, south, west and north to calm the murmur of the surrounding sky.

Then place the spiritual flag with [Yuan Yi Zhen Seal Script] engraved on both sides at the two positions of heaven and earth among the three talents, then sit cross-legged and raise another flag to occupy the human position.

The golden bells and flags are not ordinary things, they must be spiritual things. If they are in the outside world, it will take a lot of effort, but in the Jiantian Sect, it is very easy.

Lu Xuan took out the golden bell. The golden bell naturally hung in the air and floated on the clouds. Lu Xuan struck one with a jade mallet every ten breaths.

"Cang!"

"Cang!"

"Cang!"

"..."

Eight bells rang in succession, and in an instant, the eight poles were shaken. Lu Xuan did not have spiritual consciousness yet, but he still felt a silence all over his body, as if all the mixed sounds were eliminated by the bells.

To the extreme of emptiness, keep quiet.

Only when the world is quiet and the mind is at peace can we better perceive the heaven and earth and harmonize with the sky.

"Phew!"

Lu Xuan did not dare to delay and immediately took out the spiritual flag again.

The spiritual flags moved automatically without wind, hanging between heaven and earth. The whistle of the flags did not dissipate the "quietness" of the Yunting Pavilion. Instead, it was like a spiritual message, attracting the attention of heaven and earth.

Lu Xuan felt that there was an inexplicable "rhyme" flowing in the cloud pavilion, and there seemed to be various "Qi" bodies about to float out of the mountains in the distance.

At this point, the big altar ceremony was completed.

There is already [Tianyun] flowing in Yunting, which means that the people here have attracted the attention of heaven and earth.

But... it was not completely successful.

The most crucial step remains.

Only when you can see the heaven and earth and take a peek at the great road can you start the great ceremony.

The Fetus Breathing Monk cannot see the sky and has a hard time getting a glimpse of the Taoism. However, during the Great Jiao, with the help of spiritual objects and rituals, he can see a glimpse of the underworld.

The main spiritual material used in the Jiantian Sect's Qi Dajiao is the four-phase yarrow.

The leaves of this grass are as thin as feathers, and a stem grows every hundred years. It can obtain the spiritual energy of the four phases, and can communicate with gods and divination.

With the help of this grass, one can catch a glimpse of the sky in the Dajiao Cloud Pavilion.

If you can peek into the sky, you can see [Heavenly Test].

If we use the words of Lu Xuan's previous life, we can see the "examination questions".

Lu Xuan glanced at the sky, waited for a moment, and then took out two feather-like spirit leaves and placed them between his eyebrows.

"Phew!"
